program.help:
Group the per-spike microfiber atom layer (.clc) into fibers by raw-position + median-template-shape co-gating, then write the .clu/.clc/.clp triple. The .clc atoms are preserved verbatim; only .clu/.clp change. Intended for the atoms produced by a 'replace' spike-recluster: the recluster makes atoms, this makes fibers from them. After it runs, Klusters reloads the triple and the atoms appear as children of the new fibers.
Prerequisite: a .clc atom layer next to the open clustering (e.g. the output of a replace-recluster). Engine: the fiber-kit 'fiber-refiber' console script.
